title: Change at address index 2,147,483,000

wallet.mnemonic: abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon about

attack: The change really is ours, but so far past the gap limit that no wallet will find it by scanning. Whoever built the PSBT knows the index; the user does not.
rule: Warn, or refuse, when the change index is far beyond the indexes the inputs come from. A signer that does not recognise the output as change and shows it as a spend is safe too.
